Ostina is the name of an ancient town in an unknown nation. It is the birthplace of [[Phrolova]], and it is recreated in her Sonoro Sphere called the [[Lost Beyond]]. 

After being destroyed by a sudden meteorite impact in the real world, a concert hall was built on top of its remains.<ref>Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens</ref>

==Trivia==
* It is possible that the name "Ostina" is derived from the musical term ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ostinato ostinato]'', referring to a motif, phrase, or melody consistently repeated in a musical piece.
** Outside of music, Italian ''ostinato'' (English: [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/obstinate#Adjective obstinate]) refers to an intense level of stubbornness or persistence that may be viewed as irrational.
** This would align with Phrolova's unshakeable attachment to the town and its residents, despite it having been destroyed centuries ago.
** It is also possible that the name is inspired by the Roman port city of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ostia_(Rome) Ostia] on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
* It is worth noting that the town's architecture is similar to that of Ragunna; which is inspired by Venetian architecture in turn.
* Phrolova mother, '''Betty''', reverberation is nowhere to be found.
